justification: Render the now-streamed constraint_arithmetic (Development Capacity) section in the Intelligence Brief page via the existing ConstraintArithmeticCard, so the capacity headline restored to the live stream in #512 is actually visible to users. Frontend wiring only over a production-tested card.

pre_impl.existing_data: The brief page already maps every received SSE section through SectionCard, so #512's constraint_arithmetic section was already rendering as an unlabelled key-value dump. ConstraintArithmeticCard already accepts a briefData prop (pre-computed result) and skips its own fetch, and its result type carries lot_area_m2 + dev_type.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed a new card had to be built; it already exists (used in production via LepControls). Only the type needed exporting and the page needed to special-case the render.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuse, not new build: export the existing ConstraintArithmeticResult interface, import the existing card, branch the page render to use it for the constraint_arithmetic section, and add a SECTION_LABELS entry plus the section to EXPECTED_SECTIONS_DEV.

functions.name: IntelligenceBriefPage section render
functions.input: the list of received SSE section events, each holding a section name and a DataField
functions.output: a ConstraintArithmeticCard for the capacity section, the generic SectionCard for every other section
functions.if_none: when the constraint_arithmetic DataField value is null the branch falls through to the generic SectionCard which shows a not-available note

values: N/A - no regulatory values computed or hardcoded in the frontend; the card renders the values already computed by the backend constraint engine, which carries its own disclaimer field
queries: N/A - no database queries; the page consumes the SSE stream and passes the pre-computed result straight into the card via briefData

break_it.scenario: Constraint arithmetic was not computed (lot area missing) so the streamed value is null
break_it.what_happens: Passing null briefData into the card could render an empty or broken capacity card
break_it.repro: stream a development brief where constraint_arithmetic.value is null
break_it.how: the branch only renders the card when the value is truthy; otherwise it falls back to the generic SectionCard which displays the not-available reason

break_it.what_happens: A development-capacity card on an apartment lot would be misleading
break_it.how: the streaming backend only emits constraint_arithmetic for non-apartment briefs, so no capacity section arrives and the card never renders for apartments

break_it.scenario: The capacity label drifts into advisory or liability-laden wording
break_it.what_happens: User-facing copy could imply advice, suitability, or a guarantee
break_it.how: label uses hedged factual wording ('Indicative yield and the binding planning constraint'); the card itself surfaces the backend disclaimer field; no banned pre-pr-review terms present

post_merge.manual_verify: Load a development address (e.g. Penrith/Haberfield house) in /reports/intelligence-brief and confirm a 'Development Capacity' card renders with realistic GFA + binding constraint + disclaimer. Play A (population context) is the next follow-up; dual-path unification remains the documented root-cause refactor.
